summary: Iteration 5 backend-only verification of the 5 targeted fixes + full regression. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 66 to 84 tests (new classes TestIter5PresidentName, TestIter5CalendarValidation, TestIter5PrenotaAsync, TestIter5CancelPrenotazione, TestIter5ErogaValidation) and fixed a real defect IN the previous test suite (TestOrganizzazione was PATCHing president_name back to the misspelled 'Drovelli Caivano Bruno', which is why the migrated value looked wrong on the API). FINAL FULL RUN: 84/84 passed. ALL 5 FIXES VERIFIED: (1) president_name = 'Drovetti Cassiano Bruno' on the existing doc (startup $set migration) AND on a freshly recreated doc; verified inside the generated receipt PDF by inflating its ASCII85+Flate content streams ('Drovetti' present, 'Drovelli' absent). (2) POST /api/calendario now returns 422 (no more 500) for data='01/03/2026', ricorrenza_fino_al='nope', durata_min=-10, capacita=0 and capacita=-3, with no slot leaked; the happy path still returns 200. (3) POST /api/calendario/prenota is now non-blocking: 5 consecutive bookings measured 0.06-0.35s each (all << 2s) and the cancel call also < 2s (BackgroundTasks). (4) DELETE /api/calendario/prenota/{slot}/{tess} -> 404 when not booked (also 404 for unknown slot / after a successful cancel), 200 when booked, prenotazioni array emptied. (5) POST /api/compensi/eroga -> 422 for importo=-50, importo=0 and for a tecnico_id pointing at an admin; no movimento/compenso_erogato side effect; valid erogation still 200 and persisted. Regression: all iteration-3 and iteration-4 tests pass; edge_test.py improved from 1/8 to 7/8 (only the PATCH-reassign defect remains). Auth playbook re-checked: bcrypt hash starts with $2b$ (60 chars), login sets httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None+Partitioned access_token/refresh_token cookies, CORS_ORIGINS is explicit (2 origins) with allow_credentials=True, brute-force lockout tests pass, seed_admin re-hashes on password change.

minor.issue: Still NOT capped/de-duplicated - only moved off the request path. Each booking/cancel sends 1 provider call per recipient (tesserato + slot tecnico + EVERY admin). During the first full run this tripped the provider 429 'email rate limit exceeded', which then made the unrelated POST /api/ricevute/{id}/send-email return 502 for ~5 minutes (TestPdf::test_pdf_resilient_to_corrupt_images, TestEmail::test_send_email_with_pdf, TestSendTracking::test_email_tracking_fields all failed with 502 in that window and all passed once the quota recovered). Batch/limit recipients, and add retry/backoff for 429.

Every notification to the seeded admin address fails with provider 422 'Undeliverable recipient' (backend.err.log), i.e. quota is burned on a permanently undeliverable recipient on every booking. Consider a configurable notification recipient list / skipping known-bad addresses.

STILL OPEN from iteration 4: a tecnico can reassign its own slot to another tecnico by PATCHing tecnico_id (200, expected 403), and tecnico_nome is not refreshed on tecnico_id change (denormalized name goes stale). edge_test.py::test_tecnico_can_reassign_own_slot_to_other documents it.

Null values are stripped (upd filters `v is not None`), so logo_base64 / president_signature_base64 can never be cleared through the API once set - the UI cannot remove a wrong logo. Tests now reset those fields directly in mongo.
STILL OPEN from iteration 4: no cascade or DELETE endpoint for compensi_erogati, so deleting the 'Compenso tecnico' movimento leaves an orphan record (tests purge it via mongo).

minor.endpoint: GET /api/libro-soci, GET /api/calendario, public PDF link host
minor.issue: Iteration-4 minors not addressed: 'tessera' substring matching for quota_pagata_anno + N+1 ricevute query per socio; /calendario has no mandatory date range and no duplicate/overlap guard; FRONTEND_URL fallback host is still hardcoded.

action_items: Cap/de-duplicate prenotazione notification recipients and handle provider 429 (propagate 429 instead of a blanket 502) - it is the only remaining source of flaky email failures
Stop notifying the undeliverable seeded admin address on every booking (422 from provider)
Block tecnico from reassigning a slot via PATCH tecnico_id and refresh tecnico_nome when tecnico_id changes
Allow clearing nullable org fields (logo/signature) via PATCH /organizzazione
Add cascade/undo for compensi_erogati when the linked movimento is deleted
Split server.py (1203 lines) into routers and migrate @app.on_event to lifespan
critical_code_review_comments: create_slot validation is now correct but duplicated logic (durata/capacita checks) belongs on the Pydantic model as Field(gt=0) so the 422 body is a standard validation error instead of a custom detail string.

update_slot/update_org share the same `{k: v for ... if v is not None}` pattern that silently makes nullable fields unclearable - use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) without the None filter for explicitly-nullable fields.
email_utils still maps every upstream failure (422 undeliverable, 429 rate limited) to HTTPException(502, 'Invio email fallito'); the UI cannot distinguish rate limiting from a bad address.
@app.on_event('startup') is deprecated; the president_name migration is a one-shot $set that will run on every boot - fine, but move it into a lifespan handler with the other backfills.
Still no unique index on ricevute (anno, seq) - number reuse after DELETE can collide under concurrency (open since iteration 3).

success_rate.backend: 84/84 (100%) on backend_test.py; 7/8 on edge_test.py (1 documented open defect)

seed_data_creation: All ephemeral and cleaned. Post-run DB verified: slot_calendario=0, compensi_erogati=0, login_attempts=0, TEST users/tesserati/ricevute=0, movimenti categoria 'Compenso tecnico'=0, organizzazione.president_name='Drovetti Cassiano Bruno' with logo/signature reset to null. counters.ricevute_2026 seq=46.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run serially: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q -n 0 (do NOT edit pytest.ini). 84 tests, all green as of iteration 5. IMPORTANT env limitation: the emergent/Resend provider rate-limits after ~10 sends and TestPrenotazioni/TestIter5PrenotaAsync fire background notification emails; if you re-run only a subset that includes booking tests and then the email tests, expect 502s on send-email - wait ~5 min and re-run those 3 email tests (test_pdf_resilient_to_corrupt_images, test_send_email_with_pdf, test_email_tracking_fields) to confirm it is quota, not code. edge_test.py now has 1 intentional failing probe (tecnico PATCH reassign). Helper _pdf_text() in backend_test.py inflates ASCII85+Flate PDF streams - use it to assert on PDF text. Frontend has never been tested.
rca_of_the_issue: The apparent 'president_name migration not applied' failure at the start of this iteration was NOT a backend regression: the startup $set migration works (DB and a fresh doc both hold 'Drovetti Cassiano Bruno'), but TestOrganizzazione::test_signature_and_logo (written in iteration 2) PATCHed president_name to the old misspelled literal and never restored it, so the later TestPresidentName assertion read back the test's own write. Fixed the test to patch a TEST_ value and restore the canonical name. The remaining email 502s are provider rate limiting (429) caused by the still-uncapped notification fan-out; email_utils translates any non-2xx into 502, which surfaces on the unrelated send-email endpoint.
